signals.description:
A visitor standing near a fully grown male lion experienced a tense moment when a sudden sound caught the animal's attention. What began as an ordinary interaction quickly demonstrated why caution is essential around large predators.

Lions possess exceptionally sensitive hearing, allowing them to detect movements and sounds across their environment. Their ears can rotate independently to help pinpoint the direction of a noise, an important advantage when hunting or monitoring potential threats.
